title: Optimal Autoregressive Chain-of-Thought Learning via Bagging
abstract: arXiv:2611.21597v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study how to learn an autoregressive next-token generator $f\colon\Sigma^\star\to\Sigma$ from a class $\mathcal{F}$, given chain-of-thought (CoT) demonstrations of length $T$ generated by $f$. We present a simple algorithm based on bagging, which outputs a majority vote of generators that are trained to be CoT-consistent on bootstrap samples of the training data. For binary token sets, it achieves the optimal sample complexity of $O((d_{\mathrm{VC}}+\log(1/\delta))/\epsilon)$, independent of the CoT length $T$, where $d_{\mathrm{VC}}$ is the VC dimension of $\mathcal{F}$. For finite token sets $\Sigma$, the VC dimension is replaced by a multiclass analogue, the Graph dimension $d_{\mathrm{G}}$, and the sample complexity is optimal up to a $\log|\Sigma|$ factor. The number of generators in the majority-vote ensemble is $O(\log(T/\delta))$, and we show that the ensemble can be distilled into a single generator in $\mathcal{F}$ at the ex

translated_title: 通过Bagging实现最优的自回归思维链学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究如何在给定由 $f$ 生成的长度为 $T$ 的思维链（CoT）演示数据的情况下，从函数类 $\mathcal{F}$ 中学习一个自回归的下一词元生成器 $f\colon\Sigma^\star\to\Sigma$。我们提出了一种基于 bagging 的简单算法，该算法输出多个生成器的多数投票结果，这些生成器在训练数据的自助采样（bootstrap）子集上被训练为与 CoT 保持一致。对于二元词元集合，该算法达到了最优样本复杂度 $O((d_{\mathrm{VC}}+\log(1/\delta))/\epsilon)$，且与思维链长度 $T$ 无关，其中 $d_{\mathrm{VC}}$ 是 $\mathcal{F}$ 的 VC 维。对于有限词元集合 $\Sigma$，VC 维被其多分类类比——Graph 维 $d_{\mathrm{G}}$ 所取代，样本复杂度在 $\log|\Sigma|$ 因子范围内是最优的。多数投票集成中生成器的数量为 $O(\log(T/\delta))$，并且我们证明了该集成可以被蒸馏为 $\mathcal{F}$ 中的单个生成器……
tldr: 本文提出一种基于bagging的自回归思维链学习算法，通过在自助采样数据上训练CoT一致的生成器并进行多数投票集成，实现了与思维链长度无关的最优样本复杂度，且该集成可被蒸馏为单个生成器。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a bagging-based algorithm for learning autoregressive chain-of-thought generators, which trains CoT-consistent generators on bootstrap samples and aggregates them via majority voting, achieving optimal sample complexity independent of the CoT length, with the ensemble distillable into a single generator.
